purpose.zh: 把从 Google 地图发现目标企业、官网研究、公开联系方式获取、定制邮件准备到发送与回复跟进，接成一套可部署的销售开发系统。
purpose.en: Connect Google Maps company discovery, official-site research, public-contact discovery, personalized message preparation, sending, and reply follow-up in one deployable sales-development system.

originalWorkflow.zh: 销售人员按关键词和地区在 Google 地图寻找目标企业，逐个确认官网并整理名单。
originalWorkflow.en: Sales teams searched Google Maps by keyword and region, verified each official website, and assembled prospect lists.

originalWorkflow.zh: 找到企业后，还要逐家阅读官网、寻找公开联系方式，再根据对方业务单独准备开发邮件。
originalWorkflow.en: After finding a company, the team still had to read its website, locate public contacts, and prepare an outreach message for that specific business.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 从地图搜索到官网研究包含大量重复操作，名单扩大后很难保持同样的研究深度。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Moving from map search to website research required repetitive work, making it difficult to keep the same research depth as the list grew.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 统一群发模板无法利用每家企业官网里的具体业务信息，逐封人工写信又很难持续。
workflowBreakpoints.en: A generic template ignored the specific business context on each website, while writing every message by hand was difficult to sustain.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 企业来源、官网内容、联系方式、邮件草稿和发送状态分散，销售难以统一审核和继续跟进。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Company sources, website context, contacts, message drafts, and send status were scattered, making review and follow-up difficult.

systemBoundary.zh: 系统在客户控制的 Docker 环境中处理 Google 地图企业数据与公开官网信息。真实发送前必须经过人工审核和发送计划确认。
systemBoundary.en: The system processes Google Maps company data and public website information in a customer-controlled Docker environment. Real delivery requires human review and send-plan confirmation.

inputs.zh: Google 地图搜索关键词、目标地区和采集任务
inputs.en: Google Maps search keywords, target regions, and collection tasks

inputs.zh: Google 地图返回的企业名称、地址、官网等公开字段
inputs.en: Public Google Maps fields such as company name, address, and official website

inputs.zh: 企业官网公开内容，以及发件方的业务资料和营销要求
inputs.en: Public official-site content plus the sender's business profile and outreach requirements

processing.zh: 按关键词和地区从 Google 地图采集目标企业，并保留企业来源与官网
processing.en: Collect target companies from Google Maps by keyword and region while preserving source and official-site information

processing.zh: 逐家访问官网，提取业务介绍、服务信息与公开联系方式
processing.en: Visit each official website to extract business descriptions, service information, and public contacts

processing.zh: 结合对方官网内容和发件方资料生成定制开发邮件，进入人工审核与发送计划
processing.en: Use the prospect's website context and sender profile to generate a personalized message for human review and send planning

humanReview.zh: 逐条确认目标企业、官网内容、公开联系方式和定制邮件是否准确
humanReview.en: Review the target company, website context, public contacts, and personalized message for accuracy

humanReview.zh: 人工决定是否修改、发送、安排节奏或停止联系，并处理后续回复
humanReview.en: A human decides whether to edit, send, schedule, or stop contact and handles subsequent replies

outputs.zh: 包含企业来源、官网、公开联系方式和处理状态的目标客户库
outputs.en: A prospect library containing source, official website, public contacts, and processing status

outputs.zh: 依据每家企业官网内容生成、可逐条审核的定制开发邮件
outputs.en: A reviewable personalized outreach message generated from each company's website context

outputs.zh: 带发送节奏、发件账号、投递状态和回复跟进的发送计划
outputs.en: Send plans with pacing, sender account, delivery status, and reply follow-up

failureRecovery.zh: 无效记录不会被删除，而是保留明确原因供复核。
failureRecovery.en: Invalid records are preserved with explicit reasons instead of being deleted.

failureRecovery.zh: 批次支持暂停、恢复、重试、事件日志和重复文件保护。
failureRecovery.en: Batches support pause, resume, retry, event logs, and duplicate-file protection.

currentStatus.zh: 项目已形成可独立部署的 Docker 系统，覆盖 Google 地图企业发现、逐家官网分析、公开联系方式提取、定制邮件生成、人工审核、发送计划和回复监控。
currentStatus.en: The project is a self-contained Docker system covering Google Maps company discovery, official-site analysis, public-contact extraction, personalized message generation, human review, send plans, and reply monitoring.

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把 Google 地图搜索结果持续转成可研究、可联系的目标企业库
transferableCapabilities.en: Continuously turn Google Maps results into a prospect library ready for research and contact

transferableCapabilities.zh: 利用每家企业官网的真实业务内容准备定制营销信息
transferableCapabilities.en: Use real business context from each official website to prepare personalized outreach

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把企业研究、内容审核、发送节奏和回复跟进放在同一条流程里
transferableCapabilities.en: Keep company research, content review, sending pace, and reply follow-up in one workflow

transferableCapabilities.zh: 以镜像化部署交付客户可独立运行的系统
transferableCapabilities.en: Deliver a customer-operated system through image-based deployment

description.zh: 展示从 Google 地图企业发现、官网研究、定制内容生成到人工审核和发送计划的完整流程。
description.en: Shows the full workflow from Google Maps company discovery and website research to personalized content, human review, and send planning.

description.zh: 服务、API、前端、企业数据处理、发送安全与移动端可以沿同一条流程验收。
description.en: Services, API, frontend, company-data processing, send safety, and mobile behavior can be accepted through one workflow.

limitations.zh: 只处理公开企业信息，不抓取登录后页面或个人资料。
limitations.en: Processes public business information only; it does not crawl authenticated pages or personal profiles.

limitations.zh: 外联内容必须人工审核，系统不提供无差别批量自动发送。
limitations.en: Outreach content requires human review; the system does not provide indiscriminate automated bulk sending.

alt.zh: Freight Lead Agent 批次处理与人工审核界面
alt.en: Freight Lead Agent batch processing and human-review interface

purpose.zh: 把散落在企业各处的文档和业务资料整理成可检索、可引用的知识，让客服机器人、内部问答和其他 AI 应用可以使用同一份企业数据。
purpose.en: Turn documents and business information scattered across an enterprise into retrievable, citable knowledge that customer-service bots, internal Q&A, and other AI applications can share.

originalWorkflow.zh: 企业资料分散在本地文件夹、PDF、Word、Excel、PPT、图片和业务网页中，由不同部门和员工分别保管。
originalWorkflow.en: Enterprise information was spread across local folders, PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, and business web pages maintained by different teams and employees.

originalWorkflow.zh: 员工遇到问题时依靠文件名、目录和个人经验查找资料，再手工确认答案来自哪一份文档。
originalWorkflow.en: Employees relied on filenames, folders, and personal memory to find information, then manually checked which document supported an answer.

originalWorkflow.zh: 每开发一个客服机器人或内部助手，都要重新收集、清洗和导入相似资料，应用之间难以共用整理成果。
originalWorkflow.en: Each new customer-service bot or internal assistant required similar information to be collected, cleaned, and imported again, with little reuse between applications.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 不同文件格式保留结构的方式不同，表格、标题、图片文字和跨页内容直接交给 AI 后容易失去原来的语义关系。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Different formats preserve structure differently, so tables, headings, text in images, and cross-page content can lose their original relationships when sent directly to AI.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 普通搜索能找到文件，却很难同时返回可以核对的原文位置、资料完整度和来源状态。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Basic search may find a file but often cannot return a verifiable passage, its exact source location, completeness, and source status together.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 每个 AI 应用单独维护一套资料，会重复清洗数据，也会让不同应用引用到不一致的版本。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Maintaining a separate corpus for every AI application repeats data preparation and allows different applications to use inconsistent versions.

systemBoundary.zh: Hermes 运行在客户控制的本地环境中，负责资料导入、结构整理、索引、检索和带引用问答。上层客服机器人、企业聊天工具和其他业务应用通过 API 使用这些能力；渠道身份和部门权限映射由企业接入层负责，Hermes 在检索前执行已配置的知识库访问范围。
systemBoundary.en: Hermes runs in a customer-controlled local environment and handles ingestion, structural preparation, indexing, retrieval, and citation-backed Q&A. Customer-service bots, enterprise chat tools, and other business applications use these capabilities through APIs; channel identity and department mapping belong to the enterprise integration layer, while Hermes enforces configured knowledge-base access before retrieval.

inputs.zh: PDF、Word、Excel、PPT、图片和 OCR 文档等企业资料
inputs.en: Enterprise information in PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image, and OCR document formats

inputs.zh: 管理员指定的本地文件夹、单个文件、压缩包和业务网页 URL
inputs.en: Administrator-selected local folders, individual files, archives, and business web page URLs

inputs.zh: 知识库范围、资料完整度和外部应用需要查询的问题
inputs.en: Knowledge-base scope, source completeness, and questions submitted by downstream applications

processing.zh: 按文件格式提取正文、标题、表格和图片文字，并保留每段内容与原始资料位置的关系。
processing.en: Extract text, headings, tables, and image text by format while preserving the relationship between each passage and its original location.

processing.zh: 把整理后的内容写入对应知识库，建立可检索的知识节点、来源记录和完整度状态。
processing.en: Write prepared content into the relevant knowledge base and build retrievable knowledge nodes, source records, and completeness states.

processing.zh: 外部应用查询时，系统先校验 Token、接口权限和知识库范围，再返回证据片段或基于这些证据生成带引用答案。
processing.en: When an application queries the system, Hermes first checks its token, API scope, and allowed knowledge bases, then returns evidence passages or generates a cited answer from that evidence.

humanReview.zh: 管理员决定哪些文件夹和资料可以进入哪个知识库，并检查导入失败、重复文件和资料完整度。
humanReview.en: Administrators decide which folders and sources enter each knowledge base and review failed imports, duplicates, and source completeness.

humanReview.zh: 业务负责人确认检索结果和引用是否足以支持回答，再决定哪些知识库可以提供给具体应用。
humanReview.en: Business owners confirm whether retrieved evidence and citations support the answer and decide which knowledge bases each application may use.

humanReview.zh: 客服话术、对外回复和需要执行的业务动作继续由对应应用和人员审核。
humanReview.en: Customer-service wording, external responses, and business actions remain subject to review in the relevant application and by responsible staff.

outputs.zh: 按业务主题整理的企业知识库，包含来源、原文位置、完整度和处理记录
outputs.en: Enterprise knowledge bases organized by business topic with sources, original locations, completeness, and processing records

outputs.zh: 供应用直接调用的证据检索结果，以及带来源引用的知识问答
outputs.en: Evidence retrieval results ready for application use and knowledge answers with source citations

outputs.zh: 面向客服机器人、内部知识问答和其他业务助手的检索与问答 API
outputs.en: Retrieval and Q&A APIs for customer-service bots, internal knowledge Q&A, and other business assistants

failureRecovery.zh: 文件导入保留成功、失败和跳过记录；重复内容通过来源与文件指纹识别，避免无提示地重复写入。
failureRecovery.en: Ingestion preserves success, failure, and skip records, while source and file fingerprints identify duplicates instead of silently importing them again.

failureRecovery.zh: 无法完整提取的资料会保留 partial 等完整度状态，检索和回答可以据此降低承诺，不把缺失内容当成完整事实。
failureRecovery.en: Sources that cannot be fully extracted retain completeness states such as partial, allowing retrieval and answers to reduce confidence instead of treating missing content as complete fact.

currentStatus.zh: 项目目前支持 Docker Compose 本地部署，已具备文件、文件夹和 URL 导入，多格式资料整理，可追溯检索，带引用问答，以及受 Token 和知识库范围限制的检索与问答 API。
currentStatus.en: The project currently supports local Docker Compose deployment, file, folder, and URL ingestion, multi-format preparation, traceable retrieval, citation-backed Q&A, and retrieval and query APIs restricted by tokens and knowledge-base scope.

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把多个部门和多种格式的企业资料整理成一套可共用的知识来源
transferableCapabilities.en: Prepare multi-department, multi-format enterprise information as one reusable knowledge source

transferableCapabilities.zh: 让每条检索证据和回答可以回到原始文档位置核对
transferableCapabilities.en: Make every retrieved passage and answer traceable to its original document location

transferableCapabilities.zh: 让客服机器人、内部问答和后续业务助手复用同一份企业知识，减少重复导入和清洗
transferableCapabilities.en: Let customer-service bots, internal Q&A, and future business assistants reuse the same enterprise knowledge and reduce repeated ingestion and preparation

transferableCapabilities.zh: 通过知识库范围和接口权限控制不同应用能够检索的资料
transferableCapabilities.en: Control which information each application may retrieve through knowledge-base scope and API permissions

label.zh: 企业资料整理与问答流程演示
label.en: Enterprise knowledge ingestion and Q&A demo

description.zh: 展示企业资料从导入、整理和检索，到向上层应用返回证据与引用答案的过程。
description.en: Shows enterprise information moving from ingestion and preparation through retrieval to evidence and cited answers for downstream applications.

limitations.zh: Hermes 提供企业知识整理和检索内核；客服机器人、企业微信或飞书接入、界面和业务动作需要由上层应用完成。
limitations.en: Hermes provides the enterprise knowledge preparation and retrieval engine; customer-service bots, WeCom or Feishu integration, interfaces, and business actions belong to downstream applications.

limitations.zh: 原始资料缺失、过期或扫描质量过低时，系统无法凭空补齐事实，需要企业先修正资料来源。
limitations.en: When source information is missing, outdated, or poorly scanned, the system cannot reconstruct facts and the enterprise must correct the source material.

limitations.zh: 企业群聊和部门身份不能只依赖模型判断，必须由接入层明确映射到允许访问的知识库。
limitations.en: Enterprise group and department identity cannot rely on model judgment and must be explicitly mapped to allowed knowledge bases by the integration layer.

alt.zh: Hermes Notebook 企业资料导入、检索和引用问答流程
alt.en: Hermes Notebook enterprise ingestion, retrieval, and cited Q&A flow

purpose.zh: 把 Codex 接入企业飞书，让授权成员用电脑或手机共同提交、补充和验收 AI 任务，公司里保持在线的工作电脑负责继续执行。
purpose.en: Connect Codex to an enterprise Feishu workspace so authorized members can submit, clarify, and review AI tasks together from a computer or phone while an online company workstation continues the execution.

originalWorkflow.zh: 员工在飞书里讨论工作，再把需求和文件转交给会使用 Codex 的同事，由少数人代为操作。
originalWorkflow.en: Employees discussed work in Feishu, then handed requests and files to a few colleagues who knew how to operate Codex.

originalWorkflow.zh: 执行人需要在聊天、工作目录和 AI 工具之间搬运上下文，完成后再把正文与文件发回群里。
originalWorkflow.en: The operator moved context between chat, the working directory, and the AI tool, then returned responses and files to the group.

originalWorkflow.zh: 成员离开公司电脑后，很难继续发起或跟进 Codex 任务；任务等待补充时，回答和后续修改也容易与原任务分离。
originalWorkflow.en: After leaving the company workstation, members found it difficult to start or follow up on Codex tasks, while answers and revisions could become separated from tasks waiting for clarification.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 企业已经在飞书里沟通，但 AI 执行发生在另一个工具中，需求、素材和结果需要人工转运。
workflowBreakpoints.en: The company already collaborated in Feishu, but AI execution happened elsewhere, leaving people to transfer requests, materials, and results manually.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 只有少数人掌握 Codex 的工作区、工具和任务操作方式，其他成员无法直接参与复杂任务。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Only a few people understood Codex workspaces, tools, and task handling, so other members could not participate directly in complex work.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 长任务、附件任务和需要确认的任务缺少统一编号、状态查询和同一话题内的继续处理。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Long-running, attachment-based, and clarification-dependent work lacked a shared task identifier, status query, and same-topic continuation.

systemBoundary.zh: 系统运行在客户控制的工作站上，只接受已授权飞书群和成员的输入。员工可以从电脑或手机飞书发送消息与文件，公司里保持在线的工作电脑负责调用 Codex，在指定工作目录执行；任务状态和交付结果回到原飞书话题。
systemBoundary.en: The system runs on a customer-controlled workstation and accepts input only from authorized Feishu groups and members. Employees can send messages and files from Feishu on a computer or phone, while an online company workstation runs Codex in the designated directory and returns status and deliverables to the original Feishu topic.

inputs.zh: 授权成员通过电脑或手机飞书提交的问题、文案需求、分析任务或执行要求
inputs.en: Questions, writing requests, analysis tasks, and execution requests submitted by authorized group members from Feishu on a computer or phone

inputs.zh: 图片、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、PDF、视频和压缩包等任务素材
inputs.en: Task materials such as images, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, video, and archive files

inputs.zh: 同一飞书话题里的补充信息、方案确认和后续修改要求
inputs.en: Clarifications, plan confirmations, and revision requests supplied in the same Feishu topic

processing.zh: 先校验群聊与成员权限，再判断请求可以直接回答，还是需要建立可查询的正式任务。
processing.en: Validate group and member authorization, then decide whether the request can be answered directly or needs a trackable formal task.

processing.zh: 正式任务会固定本次消息、附件和话题关系，再交给公司工作电脑上的 Codex，在客户指定的工作目录中执行。
processing.en: A formal task freezes the message, attachments, and topic relationship before Codex runs it in the customer-designated workspace on the company workstation.

processing.zh: 系统持续记录受理、排队、执行、等待补充和交付状态，并把正文、附件或飞书云空间链接送回原话题。
processing.en: The system tracks acceptance, queueing, execution, clarification, and delivery states, then returns text, attachments, or Feishu cloud links to the original topic.

processing.zh: 团队可以复盘反复验证有效的任务过程，把稳定的步骤、工具选择和验收要求整理成可复用 Skill，供后续成员直接调用。
processing.en: The team can review task processes that repeatedly work and package stable steps, tool choices, and acceptance requirements into reusable Skills for other members to invoke.

humanReview.zh: Codex 缺少关键输入时会在原话题提问，授权成员给出的明确答案才能继续原任务。
humanReview.en: When key input is missing, Codex asks in the original topic and continues only after an authorized member provides an unambiguous answer.

humanReview.zh: 成员检查最终正文和附件是否完整可用，并决定是否继续修改、取消任务或开始新的话题。
humanReview.en: Members check whether the final response and attachments are complete and usable, then decide whether to revise, cancel, or start a new topic.

humanReview.zh: 部署、真实外发和付费生成等外部动作继续遵循单独授权，不由普通聊天自动触发。
humanReview.en: Deployment, real external sending, and paid generation remain separately authorized actions and are not triggered automatically by ordinary chat.

humanReview.zh: 新的 Skill 需要由团队确认适用条件、执行步骤和验收标准，再投入后续任务使用。
humanReview.en: A new Skill requires team confirmation of its conditions, execution steps, and acceptance criteria before it is used for later tasks.

outputs.zh: 在原飞书话题中返回的直接答案，或带任务编号的异步任务状态
outputs.en: A direct answer in the original Feishu topic or a trackable asynchronous task with its own identifier

outputs.zh: 由 Codex 生成或修改的正文、图片、Office 文件、视频及其他任务产物
outputs.en: Text, images, Office files, videos, and other task artifacts generated or revised by Codex

outputs.zh: 可查询的受理、执行、等待补充、完成、失败或状态不确定记录
outputs.en: Queryable records for accepted, running, waiting-for-input, completed, failed, or uncertain task states

outputs.zh: 从重复有效的工作过程中整理出的可复用 Skill，让其他成员可以按同一方法完成同类任务
outputs.en: Reusable Skills derived from repeatedly effective work processes so other members can complete similar tasks with the same method

failureRecovery.zh: 成员可以用任务编号查询或取消任务；失败、超时和结果不确定会明确返回，不把未确认结果写成成功。
failureRecovery.en: Members can query or cancel by task identifier; failures, timeouts, and uncertain outcomes are reported explicitly instead of being presented as success.

failureRecovery.zh: 飞书网络中断时保留待交付结果，恢复后按原任务继续；已经开始且结果不明的 Codex 任务不会自动重跑。
failureRecovery.en: Pending delivery is retained during Feishu network interruptions and resumes against the original task, while a started Codex task with an uncertain outcome is never rerun automatically.

currentStatus.zh: 项目已形成 Windows 10/11 x64 可部署版本。客户工作站需要安装并登录 Codex；工作电脑和桥接服务保持在线时，成员可以通过电脑或手机飞书提交任务、继续同话题协作、查询状态并接收结果。
currentStatus.en: The project has a deployable Windows 10/11 x64 release. The customer workstation must have Codex installed and signed in; while the workstation and bridge service remain online, members can submit tasks, continue same-topic collaboration, check status, and receive results from Feishu on a computer or phone.

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把企业已有的飞书群聊变成 Codex 的统一任务入口，员工离开工位后也能用手机继续工作
transferableCapabilities.en: Turn an existing enterprise Feishu group into a unified task entry point for Codex so employees can keep working from their phones after leaving their desks

transferableCapabilities.zh: 让授权成员在同一话题里共同补充信息，同时阻止跨群和跨话题取用任务上下文
transferableCapabilities.en: Let authorized members add context in one topic while preventing task context from crossing groups or topics

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把聊天消息、附件、工作目录、执行状态和最终产物接成一条可追踪流程
transferableCapabilities.en: Connect chat messages, attachments, workspaces, execution states, and final artifacts in one trackable workflow

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把团队反复验证有效的工作方式整理成可复用 Skill，让经验留在系统中，减少同类任务对个别员工的依赖
transferableCapabilities.en: Turn repeatedly proven team workflows into reusable Skills so that experience remains in the system and similar tasks depend less on individual employees

transferableCapabilities.zh: 用客户控制的 Windows 工作站交付可安装、可回滚和可检查运行状态的企业 AI 接入系统
transferableCapabilities.en: Deliver an installable, rollback-capable enterprise AI access system on a customer-controlled Windows workstation with inspectable runtime status

limitations.zh: 系统依赖客户自己的飞书应用权限和已登录的 Codex 环境，不向未授权群聊或成员开放。
limitations.en: The system depends on the customer's own Feishu application permissions and signed-in Codex environment and is not open to unauthorized groups or members.

limitations.zh: 手机飞书是远程任务入口，实际处理仍在公司的工作电脑上完成；工作电脑关机或桥接服务离线时，任务无法继续执行。
limitations.en: Mobile Feishu is the remote task entry point, while processing still happens on the company workstation; tasks cannot continue when the workstation is powered off or the bridge service is offline.

limitations.zh: 系统不会未经确认自动学习员工行为。只有经过团队复盘和确认的有效流程，才会整理成新的 Skill。
limitations.en: The system does not learn from employee behavior without confirmation. Only effective workflows reviewed and approved by the team are packaged as new Skills.

limitations.zh: 系统负责接入、任务编排和结果交付，不替代企业对最终内容、文件和外部动作的人工确认。
limitations.en: The system handles access, task orchestration, and result delivery; it does not replace human confirmation of final content, files, or external actions.
